_about: The order of stages and lessons. Each lesson id must match a file in content/lessons/.

stages.title: Foundations
stages.intro: Hold the guitar, know your fingers and strings, tune up, read diagrams and tab, and play your first two chords.

stages.title: First open chords
stages.intro: E, A, D and Dm; down-strums, down-up strumming and counting beats; your first two-chord songs.

stages.title: The full open-chord set
stages.intro: G, C and easy F; real strumming patterns; songs with three and four chords; the Andalusian cadence.

stages.title: Fingerpicking
stages.intro: Thumb and fingers (p-i-m-a), arpeggio patterns, simple tab melodies, notes on the low strings, and the rumba.

stages.title: Moving up the neck
stages.intro: Full F and barre chords, power chords, 7th chords, the minor pentatonic scale, bends and slides, and basic rasgueado.

stages.title: Understanding
stages.intro: Fluent barre chords, keys and why chords belong together, playing by ear, the flamenco scale, fast runs, and your first falseta.

paths.title: Flamenco
paths.summary: Compás (rhythm cycles), rasgueado variations, picado scales, alzapúa thumb technique and falsetas.
next: Picado (i-m rest-stroke runs) with the tempo ladder
Writing longer falsetas in E Phrygian

paths.title: Fingerstyle & classical
paths.summary: Arpeggio studies, melody with bass, and classical repertoire on the nylon guitar.
next: Classical studies by Sor and Carcassi (public domain)
Rest stroke vs free stroke tone

paths.title: Songs & lead
paths.summary: Pentatonic positions across the neck, phrasing with bends and slides, and soloing over progressions.
next: Learning the Hotel California solo from a licensed source
